aggregation: median rating per dimension, then weighted percentage

statuses.ready: score >= 80, every dimension >= 2, and no consensus critical blocker
statuses.conditional: score >= 65 and < 80, every dimension >= 2, and no consensus critical blocker
statuses.not_ready: score < 65 or a consensus critical blocker
statuses.inconclusive: missing evidence, judge failure, or unresolved disagreement
